control_group.note: All three sources include a no-AI comparison condition.

randomization.note: Bastani 2026 (large RCT), Lee 2025 (four-class RCT) and Kazemitabaar 2023 (randomized controlled experiment) all use randomized assignment.

pre_test.note: Bastani 2026 measures baseline covariates; Kazemitabaar 2023 has a pre-study evaluation; Lee 2025 baseline not fully detailed.

post_test.note: Immediate post-measures present in all sources (practice exams, homework assessments, programming tests).

retention_test.note: Kazemitabaar 2023 has a 1-week retention test; Bastani 2026 has no delayed test; Lee 2025 covers course length but no delayed retention beyond the course.

transfer_test.note: Bastani 2026's closed-book independent exam is the strongest transfer-adjacent measure (AI removed); no full novel-topic transfer task in any study.

sample_bias.note: Bastani 2026 ~950 students; Lee 2025 four intact classes; Kazemitabaar 2023 small (69) but explicitly randomized.

self_selection.note: Random assignment in all three studies limits self-selection.

measurement_validity.note: Bastani 2026 correctly separates practice/task performance from independent exam learning; but no study directly measures university mathematics concept understanding.

confounders.note: Education-level mismatch (high school / K-12 vs university) is the dominant issue; prior ability interacts with AI benefit in Kazemitabaar 2023.

instructor_effect.note: Lee 2025 runs four intact classes — class/instructor effects possible; Bastani 2026 in-class sessions may carry teacher effects.

novelty_effect.note: Short interventions and new tool exposure may inflate engagement; not controlled in any study.

tool_version_effect.note: Each study used one GPT/Codex version; rapid model iteration limits durability of findings.

ai_usage_policy.note: Bastani 2026 explicitly contrasts unguarded (GPT Base) vs guardrailed (GPT Tutor) usage policies — directly informative for policy design.

dropout.note: Attrition not systematically reported across all studies.

task_vs_learning_guard.measured_construct: practice/task performance vs independent exam performance
task_vs_learning_guard.note: Bastani 2026 provides an embedded contrast: +48%/+127% practice performance coexisted with -17% independent exam performance for the unguarded arm — practice performance must NOT be equated with learning.

limitations: No study directly targets university advanced-mathematics (calculus) students.
Subject/level directness is insufficient: high-school math (Bastani 2026), high-school English (Lee 2025), K-12 programming (Kazemitabaar 2023).
No retention beyond 1 week (Kazemitabaar 2023) or beyond course end (Lee 2025); no long-term transfer evidence.
无护栏 GPT Base 的负效应 (-17%) 说明工具设计护栏是决定因素，直接照搬通用聊天工具进入大学课堂不可行。
suggestions: Treat all conclusions as indirect until a university-mathematics study exists.
Design the pilot's guardrailed tutor on Bastani 2026's GPT Tutor design (hints, not answers).
Include a no-AI independent exam and a retention/transfer test in the evaluation plan.
Vary the AI usage policy within the pilot to isolate guardrail effects.
